We work with 3 datasets overall. First, from US Census Bureau, we decode how many agents go in each age from in the stimulation. We also make use of another dataset, that gives us an idea about contacts each age group has with every other age group. ( who interacts with whom ). Model uses these 2 datasets to stimulate what could happen with one infected person. We run it 500 times to capture uncerrainity At last, we compare results with the dataset - "utah_covid_data" from epiworldRcalibrate, which shows actual out break - the daily cases and trends, to verify accuracy of our model. ## Real Outbreak Visualization Lets visualize actual trends in cases during covid 19 using utah_covid_data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} simulated_daily <- sim_hist |> filter(state == "Recovered") |> arrange(sim_num, date) |> group_by(sim_num) |> mutate(new_cases = counts - lag(counts, default = 0)) |> ungroup() |> group_by(date) |> summarise( mean = mean(new_cases), lo95 = quantile(new_cases, 0.025), hi95 = quantile(new_cases, 0.975), .groups = "drop" ) scale_factor <- 100000 / 1200000 # model size / real SLC population real_scaled <- covid_data |> mutate( date = as.numeric(Date - min(Date)), scaled_cases = Daily.Cases * scale_factor ) |> select(date, scaled_cases) comparison <- real_scaled |> inner_join(simulated_daily, by = "date") |> mutate( residual = scaled_cases - mean, abs_error = abs(residual), squared_error = residual^2, pct_error = abs(residual) / (scaled_cases + 1) * 100, inside_ci = scaled_cases >= lo95 & scaled_cases <= hi95 ) # accuracy metrics mae <- mean(comparison$abs_error) rmse <- sqrt(mean(comparison$squared_error)) mape <- mean(comparison$pct_error) corr <- cor(comparison$scaled_cases, comparison$mean) ci_coverage <- mean(comparison$inside_ci) * 100 cat("===== MODEL ACCURACY =====\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ===== MODEL ACCURACY ===== ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat(sprintf("MAE (Mean Absolute Error): %.2f\n", mae)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` MAE (Mean Absolute Error): 2.74 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat(sprintf("RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error): %.2f\n", rmse)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error): 2.94 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat(sprintf("MAPE (Mean Abs Pct Error): %.1f%%\n", mape)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` MAPE (Mean Abs Pct Error): 70.9% ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat(sprintf("Correlation (r): %.3f\n", corr)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Correlation (r): 0.315 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat(sprintf("CI Coverage (real inside 95%% CI): %.1f%%\n", ci_coverage)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` CI Coverage (real inside 95% CI): 0.0% ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} comparison |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |> rename( Day = date, `Real (scaled)` = scaled_cases, `Sim mean` = mean, `Sim 2.5%` = lo95, `Sim 97.5%` = hi95, Residual = residual, `Abs error` = abs_error, `Inside 95% CI` = inside_ci ) |> kableExtra::kable(caption = "Actual vs Simulated — Day by Day") |> kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) |> kableExtra::row_spec( which(!comparison$inside_ci), background = "#fff3cd" # highlight days outside CI ) |> kableExtra::scroll_box(height = "400px") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
